name: salespilot-crm
description: Static fully functional CRM demo with local browser storage and demo login roles.

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['index.html','styles.css','app.js']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(f+' missing'); } const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); if (!html.includes('app.js') || !html.includes('styles.css')) throw new Error('index assets missing'); console.log('CRM static checks passed');"
